semiconductor_relevance: High — Rigaku Corporation specializes in X-ray metrology solutions that are critical for semiconductor wafer evaluation and analysis.
summary: Rigaku Corporation provides advanced X-ray metrology tools for semiconductor processes, focusing on wafer surface analysis, film thickness measurement, and crystallinity evaluation. Their innovative technologies support a wide range of applications in the semiconductor industry, including logic, memory, and RF devices.
capabilities: X-ray metrology for wafer surface metal contamination analysis
Ultra-fast mapping for contamination analysis with TXRF systems
Advanced X-ray source and optics technologies
